responsibility: This file implements the source scanner that loads Fortran source files into memory, tracks loci, and presents normalized character streams to the parser. It manages include files and search paths, fixed/free form handling, continuation lines, preprocessing handoff and #line tracking, wide-character and encoding helpers, source-file/original-filename reconstruction, directive detection for OpenMP/OpenACC/GCC attributes, and line-buffer construction used by diagnostics and matchers.
same_name_distinction: Contains the full scanning implementation: file loading, line buffering, continuation and include handling, preprocessing/#line tracking, locus maintenance, directive detection, and wide-character utilities. Unlike gcc/fortran/scanner.h, it is not just search-path metadata declarations but the operational source scanner used before parsing.
